description:
Pédalons is the home of your cycling club or group: rides, routes, the agenda and team news, all in one place.

RIDES
• Every ride offers its pace groups: sign up for yours in one tap, and see who is riding with whom.
• Start location and time, planned route, comments: everything you need to know before heading out.
• The ride's weather in the week before it: at the start, then along the route at your group's pace — rain, temperature, and headwind or tailwind, point by point, right on the map.
• Multi-day trips, stage by stage, with the weather for each stage.

ROUTES
• The club's route library, on the map or as a list, filtered by distance and elevation; Explore opens the map of every route of your teams.
• An elevation profile coloured by gradient or by surface, and the climbs along the way.
• The route's points on the map and the profile: regroups, food stops, water, cafés, summits, hazards…
• Download as GPX or FIT, and send a route to your Hammerhead Karoo or Garmin bike computer — or have routes sent automatically, service by service.
• For organizers: draw a route on the map, generate one from a start point and a distance, import GPX files, or retouch an existing route.
• GPX tools: view, merge and share your own files, and send them to your bike computer.

THE TEAM
• Each team's dashboard: your next rides, the latest posts, new routes and ads.
• The agenda of rides and trips, as a list or a calendar, which you can subscribe to from your own calendar app.
• Club posts, to keep everyone in the loop.
• Classified ads between members, without your e-mail address ever being shown.
• Notifications for ride reminders, schedule changes and replies to your comments, set type by type.

A Pédalons account is created with an e-mail address; sign-in works with a password, a one-time code or passkeys.
whatsNew:
• Create a route in the app: draw it on the map, generate it from a start point and a distance, or import one or several GPX files at once, with progress and a summary.
• Retouch a route: aim at a distance or move the finish without touching the rest of the track — or edit a copy when you cannot edit the original.
• GPX tools come to the app: view, merge, find your files, edit them, share them, send them to your bike computer or save them as a team route.
• Drawing a route: optional routing by the Pédalons engine, with “Traffic” and “Avoid main roads”; search results stay within the map; an up-to-date monthly quota, greyed out once reached.
• A single edit button on a route: edit, duplicate, retouch, delete.
• A single “Create” button on the team page and in its Agenda, Routes and Posts tabs: ride, trip, route or post.
• “GPS” in the header of rides, groups, stages and routes; its sheet tells you, service by service, where the route stands: already sent and when, an older version to send again, a send in progress or failed, a service to reconnect.
• Invitation links open the app, and bring you back to it once your account is created.
• Members: managing them opens from the list, and every role can be changed, Administrator included.
• Team pages that are drafts, hidden or members-only say so in the menu.
• More links from the website open straight in the app, full-screen maps included.
• Stability fixes.
